sources.title: BIS interim final rule 'Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors' (Federal Register doc. 2026-23529, public inspection 16.11.2026, publication 19.11.2026)

against.note: The 12.11 valuation (three worlds 45/35/20, weighted base 169.02 at 161.50) was frozen in the ledger on 2026-11-16 08:37 UTC (thesis 23d65c1b86a9, which superseded the 15.11 row 8f0762821d89 of the same valuation), before the report of 17.11. FY2027 is the base year, not a model year: the model's only FY2027 figure is rev0 (410,000 = H1 actual + the Q3 guide 108.0B + the Q4 consensus 124.5B), so the quarter is scored as partial and guidance rows.

items.metric: revenue Q3 FY2027 against the Q3 guide inside the frozen FY2027 base
items.note: release: 115,844M (+20% q/q, +103% y/y), +7.3% over the 108.0B guide the frozen rev0 used; includes about 2.4B of Hopper shipped to China (CFO commentary). Data Center 107.6B. No ahead/behind word on a partial year.
release: 74.8% GAAP, 74.9% non-GAAP; the frozen notes carried the Q3 guide of 74.0% +-0.5; the model has no gross-margin line

release: operating income 77,520M on 115,844M. Model value = the roughly 65% FY2027 level the frozen notes assumed (FY2027 is not a model year); the frozen FY2028 weighted base margin is 60.45% (ledger)

items.metric: revenue FY2027, nine months actual + Q4 guide midpoint (reported, 53 weeks)
items.note: 293,681M (release, 9M) + 130,000M Q4 guide (+-3%, a 14-week quarter): 423.7B (range 419.8-427.6B), +3.3% over the frozen 410.0B, which used the 14-week consensus 124.5B for Q4. On a 52-week basis (13/14 of the Q4 guide) 414.4B, +1.1%. Guidance, not a reported number; the period ends 31.1.2027.

items.metric: operating margin FY2027 (GAAP), nine months actual + Q4 guide
items.note: 9M operating income 194,791M + Q4 about 81,950M (130.0B x 71.5% - 11.0B opex) on 423.7B; model value = the roughly 65% the frozen notes assumed
